new_cases.distinction: Same event with opposite booleans and equal confidence; neither reporter wins.
Later report contradicts an earlier report; no retraction predicate exists.
Three reporters give distinct entity locations at the same event.
Conflicting signed integer counts are retained, never averaged.
Empty reported text is content; absence of a destination assertion is different.
Visually similar composed and decomposed strings must remain distinct.
Arabic text and embedded directional marks are exact evidence content.
Joined emoji with a skin modifier differs from separate glyphs.
Text includes tab, CRLF, NUL and a backslash, all preserved inside a literal.
Instruction-like text is quoted data rather than authority.
Minimum and maximum signed 64-bit values are literal counts, not floats.
A zero count is known while a negative value is a separate report.
Equal event, record and interpretation clocks are allowed.
Interpretation precedes recording numerically; no ordering constraint is invented.
Pre-epoch events and later records retain signed times.
Extreme signed times remain exact without arithmetic conversion.
Equal event times do not authorize record-order truth resolution.
An unknown event must not be replaced by the record time when sorting.
Same content/event recorded once but interpreted at distinct times remains two assertions.
The newest recording reports the oldest event.
Zero, unknown and maximum confidence are three distinct values.
Threshold comparison applies only to known numeric confidence, not truth.
Maximum reported confidence does not erase a conflicting low-confidence report.
Even maximum confidence inference remains inferred attribution.
An observation can have unknown confidence without losing method.
Identical values from two reporters remain two separately attributed claims.
Observed, reported and inferred assertions share a source but retain distinct methods.
An entity can assert a fact about itself; attribution is still explicit.
Different fact kinds cite the same full report; digest identity is evidence, not truth.
Inference record and interpretation clocks do not invent an event time.
A directed entity relation cannot be inverted silently.
A self reference is valid and differs from an absent edge to a second item.
Two hops do not authorize an unstated transitive assertion.
A two-node cycle preserves both directed claims.
Multiple entity targets coexist without implicit uniqueness.
Two subjects can point to one location without conflating subject identities.
Same entities with distinct predicates preserve relationship identity.
Coincident booleans carry no causal relationship.
The string null is a known text value; the event null is unknown.
Text false and boolean false retain different typed meanings.
Leading zeros and plus sign in text are not numeric normalization candidates.
NaN is permitted as text, never a numeric confidence or count.
Leading, trailing and nonbreaking whitespace in text are preserved.
JSON-looking text remains a single literal rather than extra assertions.
Non-ASCII entity and predicate identifiers preserve references exactly.
A long literal exercises length encoding across small-string boundaries.
Time and confidence filters must be combined without filling unknowns.
Report attribution and event cutoff select a different claim than record cutoff.
Opposed text reports at an unknown event retain zero and unknown confidence.
An inferred later location does not become a later observation.
Negative event, zero confidence, empty text and a directed link coexist.
All semantic metadata may coincide while distinct assertion ids remain retained.
Absence of a ready assertion is different from an explicit false tested assertion.
A conjunction rule selects one subject across six facts without unstated facts.
